children: Overview
Hong Kong property developer's H1 revenue fell yr/yr to RMB 15.1 bln
Company posted net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 740 mln for H1
Total debt decreased by RMB 2.4 bln, average financing cost fell to 2.75%
Outlook
Poly Property Group plans to launch five new projects in H2, subject to construction progress and market conditions
Result Drivers
LOWER CONTRACTED SALES - Co reported contracted sales of RMB 23.2 bln for the period, with contracted area of 799,000 square metres and average selling price of RMB 29,051 per square metre
LEGACY PROJECT PRESSURE – Legacy-project profitability pressure and delivery timing cut recognised revenue and gross margin, resulting in a RMB740 mln loss
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT GROWTH – Property management revenue rose 5.0% to RMB656 mln as managed GFA increased 3.4% to 55.93 mln sq m
COST CONTROL - Total debt decreased by RMB 2.4 bln and average financing cost fell to 2.75%

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the real estate rental, development & operations peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Poly Property Group Co Ltd is HK$2.98, about 101% above its August 27 closing price of HK$1.48
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 18 three months ago
